goal: Build minimal Android and iOS reference apps that consume the same P2 domain contracts and exact Wave 1/2 receipts, proving provider selection, embedded/system fallback, skill execution, bounded DAG workflows, model rollback, lifecycle handling and exact device receipts without product-specific business logic.

convergence_strategy.rule: Read bytes only from the declared immutable heads and copy only scenario-required provider/model/skill/core/eval surfaces into an isolated P8 convergence worktree for build/test. Do not merge sibling PRs or infer completion from branch existence.
convergence_strategy.collision_policy: Any same-path byte disagreement, stale receipt, or unlisted source path is Shadow L3 and stops convergence.
convergence_strategy.history_policy: Sibling histories remain independent Draft PRs; P8 records consumed blob identities in its convergence receipt.

required_scenarios: embedded TLM function/tool proposal with host authorization
metadata-first skill load and sandbox execution
two-stage chained specialist pipeline through host-owned bounded DAG
offline mode with no undeclared network egress
positive_gates: all consumed exact receipt and blob identities validate before tree assembly
Android and iOS reference apps consume P2 contracts without provider types crossing the shared boundary
system and embedded provider selection/fallback remains typed and visible
ToolProposal never becomes side-effect authority without P5 admission
P6 candidate DAG is validated before execution
model activation/rollback binds P4 artifact identity
Android build and iOS build each record pinned toolchain evidence
device receipt binds exact app commit/device/OS/provider/runtime/model/skill/observed backend
negative_controls: unlisted source path copied into convergence tree -> FAIL
private Workspace URL/resolver value/private roadmap -> FAIL
requested accelerator promoted to observed backend -> FAIL
ToolProposal executes without host admission -> FAIL
device receipt missing runtime/model/device/observed backend -> FAIL
lifecycle cancellation leaves active session or sandbox residue -> FAIL
start_dependencies: P2/P3A/P3B/P3C/P3D/P4/P5/P6/P7 exact STATIC/LOCAL receipts are readable
all selected input refs are immutable and no writer lease overlaps P8
completion_dependencies: Android build receipt on pinned Gradle/SDK toolchain
iOS/Xcode build receipt on pinned Xcode/iOS SDK
physical-device receipts for selected system and embedded paths
P3C/P3D runtime-observed backend receipts for selected devices
P7 same-model runtime parity/model-quality receipt when model-quality claims are made
privacy/network/power/thermal lanes remain explicit rather than inferred
Human-owned terms/signing/store transitions separately admitted if required
evidence_ceiling: This task packet admits convergence work only. Static/local exact inputs do not prove reference-app builds, physical backend/device coverage, privacy, power, thermal behavior, model quality, terms, signing, store readiness, merge or release.
human_owned_operations: App Store or Google Play publication

handoff.draft_pr_rule: Do not create a P8 Draft PR for a task-packet-only branch. Open only after real reference-app/convergence bytes and owning static/local build gates exist.
handoff.local_handoff_rule: Missing Xcode, Android SDK, signing, terms, model access or physical devices become typed Local Handoff items; never infer PASS.
